answer.rationale: P99 latency is 5x target and confined to primary region. Regional failover successfully restored latency during March degradation with clean traffic shift and fast error recovery (memory_b2). Rollback is blocked by compliance requirement on security patch. Read replica routing (memory_b5) addresses reporting load, not write path latency. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) contain failures but don't resolve the primary degradation. Adding capacity takes time we don't have during settlement peak. Failover immediately removes the bottleneck region while preserving all writes through the secondary. Settlement traffic continuity is maintained.
